functions.residue: RESIDUE SCHED 49 same instructions, different order over 18 site(s)
functions.notes: Ran colorsweep --apply (no change) and about 17 gate variants (ToInt return types, local unsigned char temps, unsigned int bitfields, int temp for valD) with no reduction. Target loads the old bitfield byte before the 'and r0,#0xff' at the valD, mid and flagE7 stores, and computes 'add r0,r5,#imm' after the orr; ours loads after the and and computes the add early. Fields initialisation block is required (removing it is 120 bytes short).
